lines.text: [3:12=Three_twelve]*y [AM.=A.M.]/ The loudest thing for thirty miles/ is your gas station.*r/
The lights hum./ The ice machine rattles./ The sign buzzes.*y/
Your shift:/ one crowbar.*y/ One walkie-talkie.*y/
A whole store of water and snacks./ And the shutter switch.*y/
Then the walkie crackles.*r/
All stations./ They hunt by sound.*r/ Go silent.*r/ Now./
You kill the hum./ You unplug the ice machine./
Then the shutter.*y/
The motor screams.*r/
It jams./ Knee height.*r/
Silence./
Then bass.*r/ Headlights./ A car pulls up to pump two,/ music blasting.*r/
On the camera,/ something on the canopy roof/ turns its head.*r/
You can't shout./ You reach under the gap/ and wave.*y/
He sees you./ Then he sees it.*r/ He runs./
He's under the shutter/ when it hits the metal.*r/
Now there are two*y of you behind the counter./
And he can't stop breathing.*r/
A grey hand*r slides under the gap./ Feeling./ Listening.*r/
You press your hand over his mouth./
It slides away./
Outside,/ his radio is still playing.*y/ They're all over the car.*r/
Then the walkie whispers.*y/
Church on [Route_9=Route_nine].*y/ Doors open till dawn./
He holds up his keys.*y/ Dawn is three hours*r away./
Your call./
